accounting.scope: self-attention + MLP; zero q/k/v bias rows (3 x width) are counted

charts.method: ridge (mediafold.linalg.fit_ridge_linear, fp64) refitted on every paired row at the lambdas chosen by the c17 fit-split ladder

pairs.host_site: block 31 OUTPUT (the residual the charted block inserted after layer 31 reads)

charts.policy: owner 2026-10-06: these numbers are diagnostics, never gates

time_rows.how: the time rows are ordinary rows of both charts; each is replicated `weight` times in the fit design (split fit: fit time rows only; record: every time row)

weight_choice.policy: design parameter chosen from measurements (owner 2026-10-06); recorded, never a gate
weight_choice.rule: DESIGN (fixed before the sweep ran): the weight with the lowest held time-row forward relL2 (4 d.p.) among weights whose held content-row forward relL2 is within +1% of the weight-1 value; ties -> the smaller weight

charts.valid_only_with: the latent interface rows these host rows were captured under (s7/interface_latent) and the S3 trunk prefix 0..31; S5 (C10 rewrites FFNs 0-31) needs a recapture

holdout.note: Codex fold_receipt candidate_diagnostics (block_output relL2 etc.); not re-derived here

hy3d_time_token_row.charted_block_effect: an owned type-7 row like the latent rows: chart_in reads it, the block attends to it, and the block delta is written back to it (as the parent updates row 0)
hy3d_time_token_row.installer_check: none in c16 1.2.0 (it loads modulation-none containers without a time gate); the row is a runtime layout contract: the S7 driver must emit it at inference exactly as s7_host_rows emits it
hy3d_time_token_row.layout: each volume segment = [1 time-token row | latent rows], all type_id 7, contiguous, time row FIRST
hy3d_time_token_row.pairing: R3 pairs the time row trunk state with the parent block-10 INPUT row 0 (the evolved time token), not with t_embedder(t); the block-0 token is shipped only as a reference

pairing_implemented_by.s7_chart_fit: >= 1.1.0: refuses paired rows without time rows for this unit; time rows are rows of both charts (fit-design weight recorded in charts.time_rows)
pairing_implemented_by.s7_host_rows: >= 1.2.0: runs the trunk prefix over [prompt | time row | latent rows], validates this layout structurally and refuses pairs without time rows for this unit; writes time_row into paired_rows
pairing_implemented_by.s7_pairs_parent: >= 1.1.0: hy3d keeps block_input row 0 as the forward's first row (time_row=True, zero features, feature_width 0, position [-1,-1,-1,-1], the segment sigma)

hy3d_time_token_row.reference: FP32 t_embedder(sigma) at sigma 0.00..1.00 step 0.05 = the block-0 time row; the block-10 row has evolved

reference_vs_block0_capture.note: diagnostic only: the capture ran the parent in F16; a wrong sinusoid scale (x1000) or cos/sin order gives O(1)

hy3d_time_token_row.time_row_feature: all zeros over native_feature_dim (no latent content)
hy3d_time_token_row.time_row_noise_level: the segment sigma in [0, 1] (the same value as its latent rows): the bridge noise_proj is then the only content-bearing input of that row
hy3d_time_token_row.time_row_position: thwr_v1 [-1, -1, -1, -1] (reserved: no latent row uses a negative coordinate)
hy3d_time_token_row.what: the parent time token: HunYuanDiTPlain prepends t_embedder(t) as sequence row 0 (x = cat([t, x_embedder(latents)], dim=1)); every block self-attends over it and updates it

s7_unit.built_by: parent F16 block tensors + Codex dense child MLP (read only)
s7_unit.charts_status: PRESENT at hidden 5120 (lane PREP-B 2026-10-11, 2026-10-10); fitted on S3-trunk host rows under the latent interface set; time rows 4 x weight 4096 (runtime_requirements.hy3d_time_token_row)

component_4x.rule: c16 components(): child MLP / parent MLP <= 0.25 registers as --component

deviations: cross-attention to DINO context dropped (structural, see structural_limitation_owner_decision)

options: accept the drop (conditioning reaches the volume rows only through the trunk context)
extend the charted kind with a conditioning chart (new model code in chimera-omni + c16; context rows would come from trunk text/image rows through a second [1024 x 5120] chart)
structural_limitation_owner_decision.what: cross-attention attn2 to the DINO image conditioner (1370 x 1024 context rows) is dropped
structural_limitation_owner_decision.why: the charted block kind (chimera-omni modeling/charted.py) carries no conditioning input: a block reads only the trunk rows it owns (plus H3 text rows through the same chart); attn2.to_k/to_v expect 1024-wide DINO features, not trunk rows

s7_unit.time_token: RESTORED as a runtime row: runtime_requirements.hy3d_time_token_row (the block sees it in self-attention); charts must be fitted on paired rows that carry it (s7_chart_fit >= 1.1.0 refuses otherwise)

metadata.cross_attention: attn2 (DINO image context) dropped: the charted kind has no conditioning input (structural; owner decision)
metadata.qkv_bias: zero rows written (source q/k/v have no bias; out_proj does)
metadata.time: time token = ROW 0 of the volume segment, an owned type-7 row (runtime_requirements.hy3d_time_token_row); the block attends to it exactly as the parent self-attention does (modulation none: HY3D has no adaLN)
